Name: Vampire Haley cow photos
Author: rezop
Description:
[center]So I was browsing the mods here in the nexus when I came upon this one the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1572][size=4]Haley Vampire Revamp[/size][/url]﻿. Since I thought that Haley was a total bitch and I like vampires (who doesn't?) I decided to download it. I like the mod a lot, there was only one problem the eighth heart event. The photos with the cows still had normie Haley in them instead of the vampire one. I saw this in the game and said to myself GOD DAMN IT! So I went back to the original page looked at the post section and saw that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46556962][size=4]SextingWithSirens[/size][/url]﻿ the original poster of the Mod had said that they could not find the sprites of Haley with the cows and when I saws that I said to myself SHIT, if they couldn't find it I definitely wouldn't be able to. Well I found it albeit by complete and total accident but still, I found it. Then I edited the sprites so that vampire Haley was in the cow photos instead of that weird normal Haley.

[size=4]I then contacted SextingWithSirens asking for their permission to upload what I had edited and was giving the go ahead so here it is.

[/size][size=3][u]Installation:[/u] Download the file, unzip it and drop it into the LooseSprites folder if it ask you to overwrite click yes (duh).

Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46556962]SextingWithSirens[/url]﻿ and whomever they credited and 5% to me because all I did was stumble upon the sprites and edited the photos, everything else goes to them.
